verdict.rationale: An email platform with Marketing Campaigns could plausibly offer versioning and rollback for automations, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of versioning, review, or rollback for automations. The only versioning evidence covers multiple versions of dynamic email templates, an adjacent content feature that does not transfer to automation workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
